title: Equestrian Center
specs: Eleven stall courtyard barn with private runs and nine stall row barn with paddocks
Lighted riding rings including a 300’x175’ ring surrounded by oak trees and a full size dressage court
includes: Top quality care for horses including feeding good quality hay, custom grain mix, daily wormer, and trace mineral blocks
Use of multiple riding arenas including 300’x175’ ring, covered ring, outdoor sand ring, dressage court, and round pen

blurb: Guests can take riding lessons ranging from 30 to 60 minutes depending on skill and budget. The center provides full board facilities with top quality care for horses including stalls, turnout services, and multiple riding arenas. Amenities include multiple barns, tack rooms, wash racks, lighted rings, and daily stall cleaning except Sundays.
